name: Product Line and SLA
purpose: Define reusable Product Line identity, customer-specific Contract Product Line SLA authority, SR classification, exact elapsed calculations, canonical monthly cohorts, live SLA projections and immutable report evidence.

decisions.decision: Product Line is reusable reference identity; each Contract belongs to exactly one Customer Organization; each Contract Product Line couples one Contract to one Product Line and owns its customer-specific SLA policy.

An SR has at most one active Contract Product Line classification and it must belong to the SR's resolved Customer; classification is deterministic/reviewed and Advanced Search Product has no authority.

Current SLA calculation is a reproducible projection over accepted SR facts plus the current accepted Contract Product Line policy; policy/classification revisions recalculate current projections without rewriting completed report evidence.
Effective SLA duration is max(0, endpoint - accepted Report Date - cumulative accepted source-reported suspension), using exact whole-second/integer-or-decimal arithmetic without premature rounding.

Active endpoint is current canonical instant; eligible terminal endpoint is first accepted effective Resolved/Closed; Cancelled preserves history but is excluded from cohorts; missing Report Date is explicitly uncalculable.

Canonical SLA cohort membership uses Report Date month in America/Guayaquil and partitions by Customer, Contract, Contract Product Line, severity and policy tier. Compliance outcome/state is derived after membership and is never a cohort-key dimension.
Individual SR SLA state and cohort compliance percentage/state are separate projections.
Daily/Weekly/range views are dated progress snapshots of canonical monthly contractual cohorts; an open month is never labeled final.
A completed report becomes immutable historical evidence only after successful artifact verification from one consistent accepted-state snapshot.
Failed/cancelled report attempts and SLA recalculation never authorize operational cleanup or history deletion.
